title: Remote MCP host isolation and OAuth live readiness

phases.objective: Define a reviewable fail-closed contract for canonical Remote MCP host admission, explicit OAuth resource routing, trusted proxy boundaries, no-secret readiness diagnostics, source validation, and separately governed live activation without granting runtime or provider mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Spec 017 manifest, requirements, E2E contract, and implementation handoff
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives one canonical topology and an implementation-ready correction plan that explicitly separates source changes from DNS, TLS, migration, secret, DCR, client-registration, deployment, and Production authorities.
steps: Load the Spec 017 manifest and canonical topology.
Verify that only mcp.mad4b.com is the declared Remote MCP resource host while auth.mad4b.com remains the OAuth issuer and Tenant GPT core resource.
Verify that wrong-host MCP requests and unknown protected-resource metadata hosts are required to fail closed.
Verify that forwarded host headers are not authority unless a trusted deployment boundary explicitly enables them.
Verify that readiness output is administrative, bounded, and contains no secret values.

Verify that migration apply, signing-secret provisioning, DNS/TLS/proxy mutation, DCR registration, canary activation, real client acceptance, and Production promotion remain separately authorized live phases.
assertions: The canonical MCP endpoint remains https://mcp.mad4b.com/mcp.
The canonical OAuth issuer remains https://auth.mad4b.com/auth/mcp.
auth.mad4b.com/mcp is not accepted as a substitute canonical MCP endpoint.
No source-only specification artifact authorizes live migration, secret, provider, feature-flag, client-registration, deployment, or Production mutation.
Rollback never requires dropping OAuth evidence tables.
No secret value or account-specific OAuth callback is committed.

phases.objective: Implement canonical Remote MCP host admission, explicit protected-resource routing, bounded proxy host trust, DCR-advertisement readiness, no-secret administrative readiness, environment documentation, and exact regression coverage without enabling any live Remote MCP or OAuth feature flag.

e2e_journeys.actor: Approved Remote MCP client and platform operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Canonical /mcp transport, protected-resource metadata, authorization-server metadata, and admin readiness readback
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Only the configured MCP resource host can reach the Remote MCP transport, each known resource host receives only its own OAuth metadata, DCR is advertised only with a usable redirect policy, and operators can inspect bounded readiness without receiving secrets.
steps: Resolve the effective request host through one normalized helper and ignore forwarded-host headers unless explicit trusted-proxy mode is enabled.
Admit /mcp only when the effective host exactly equals the configured Remote MCP resource host.
Reject issuer, Activation, unknown, malformed, and ambiguous hosts before MCP execution.
Route protected-resource metadata explicitly among the Remote MCP resource, Tenant GPT core resource, and Activation resource, returning 404 for unknown hosts.
Advertise the Remote MCP DCR registration endpoint only while DCR is enabled and a usable redirect policy exists.
Expose admin-protected readiness that reports configuration and OAuth persistence prerequisites as booleans and bounded metadata without secret values.
Execute canonical host, metadata routing, readiness, OAuth profile, OAuth route, access-token, disabled-boundary, and canonical test-manifest checks on the exact source head.
assertions: activation.mad4b.com/mcp and unknown hosts fail closed.
Forwarded-host headers are not trusted by default.
Tenant GPT scopes never become Remote MCP scopes merely because /mcp is reachable on another virtual host.
Unknown protected-resource hosts do not silently inherit Tenant GPT metadata.
The readiness response never serializes the OAuth signing secret or OAuth grant values.
DCR metadata remains absent when redirect policy is unavailable.
No DNS, TLS, reverse-proxy, migration, secret, feature-flag, OAuth-client, deployment, or Production mutation is inferred from source tests.

phases.objective: Prove malformed and spoofed host denial, proxy misconfiguration failure behavior, database-readiness dependency faults, refresh/revocation parity, expiry handling, and rollback-safe observability.

Under separate live authorization, verify exact deployed SHA, DNS/TLS/reverse-proxy host preservation, OAuth persistence migration, signing-secret readiness, bounded DCR, MCP Inspector, and one approved ChatGPT canary connection.
Under separate Production authorization, prove public routing, metadata parity, ChatGPT reconnect/refresh, revocation, tenant isolation, monitoring, rollback, and exact deployed-source parity.
